method: Fresh `git clone --shared` at the commit; TMPDIR under ~/.tmp; SELFTEST_WORKERS=4. Two runs of docs/evidence/syzygy-0yit/profile_selftest.py, which calls `selftest()` in-process with phase and per-case timers and edits nothing in scripts/: a timing-only run (the wall figures here) and a cProfile run (parent profile plus one profile per pooled case; cProfile inflated the wall 1.45x, so its seconds are used for attribution only). Both runs: SELFTEST PASS, 632 of 632 mutants killed, 146 of 146 controls held, identical witness files. Host shared with other lanes [Observed: load average 1.2-2.4 at the end of each run]. measure_scope.py measured proposal 1 on one scratch copy without editing scripts/. The timing run used profile_selftest.py before one later edit, which only changed the --cprofile branch (a worker now disables the parent profiler it inherits through fork; without it the first cProfile attempt failed with 'Another profiling tool is already active'); the recorded digest is of the file both the cProfile run and this record used.
findings: [Observed] 115 of 856 s run in the forked pool (118 cases, 452 worker-seconds, 3.83 s mean, so about 98% of 4 workers); the remaining ~725 s run serially in the parent after the pool.

[Observed] _entry_kind_cases alone is 444 s serial (52% of the wall). In the parent profile, 8 calls to its `lambda t: check_outcomes(t, Report())` arm (check_spec_reconciliation.py:12413, through _library_error) are 472.8 of its 498.4 profiled seconds.

[Observed] That arm calls check_outcomes outside run(), so `_SIGNED_MEMO` is None and every reference_signed reaches is_signed: 211 is_signed calls in the parent against about one per run() in the workers (120 for 118 cases). measure_scope.py: one bare check_outcomes call is 49.4 s with 22 is_signed calls; the same call inside run()'s per-run scope is 3.0 s with 1 call, and the findings are equal.

[Observed] The other 35 serial families total 274 s, each 4-29 s (url_source_cases 29.4, edit_account_cases 19.6, term_brief_cases 17.5, declared_source_historical_cases 13.7). declared_source_historical_cases makes the same bare check_outcomes call (check_spec_reconciliation.py:7188).

[Inferred] Growth: a pooled case adds ~3.8 worker-seconds, about 1 s of wall at 4 workers; a new serial family (one per recent specification amendment, 19 of them from figure_cases to worth_cases at 4-10 s each) adds its whole wall. The serial families, not the case count, set the slope.

proposal.change: Give the bare check_outcomes calls the per-run scope run() already sets up: factor run()'s `_SIGNED_MEMO`/`_RUN_MEMO`/memoized-D10-state setup into one context manager, enter it in run() and around the two bare check_outcomes calls (_entry_kind_cases' check_outcomes arm, declared_source_historical_cases). Removes repeated work; adds no cache.
proposal.estimatedSavingSeconds: 300-370 at 4 workers (8 calls x ~46 s measured, minus attribution error; plus ~10 s from line 7188)
proposal.codeSize: ~15 lines changed in check_spec_reconciliation.py, net about +5
proposal.risk: None to verdicts if the scope is the run() scope exactly: findings measured equal on the clean copy; the selftest witness must stay byte-identical.

proposal.change: Run the serial `*_cases` families (and the inline two-case block) through the existing fork pool, one family per task, each returning its witnesses and failures, merged in the current order. Forks already isolate the families' global patches (poc_d10_cases' amendment, _cli_exits' ROOT).
proposal.estimatedSavingSeconds: ~190 at 4 workers after P1 (274 s of families plus the ~70 s left of _entry_kind_cases spread over 4 workers, bounded below by the largest, 29 s)
proposal.codeSize: ~40 lines in check_spec_reconciliation.py (a family table and a second _map_cases-style call); families' printed SKIPPED/note lines move to worker stdout and must be re-emitted in order
proposal.risk: Witness order and stdout order must be preserved; families that read a shared tree must not write it (each already copies its own).

notKept: the 118 per-case cProfile files (9.3 MB compressed); their sums are in summary-1c42a078.txt.
